heading: Power Metering System

text: The EPM 5300 advanced power meter measures voltage, current, power, energy, demand and harmonics with revenue accuracy. Compared to other meters in its class, it adds advanced harmonics measurements, including THD, K-Factor and individual magnitudes and phase angles to the 31st order. It features both Modbus and DNP 3.0 open communication protocols ensuring easy system integration. It provides advanced control functions. The digital display is bright, easy to read, and requires no user training. The EPM 5300 is a panel mount meter.
